approach: Static recompilation of the PPU and SPU code to C++ with ps3recomp, HLE system libraries, Direct3D 12 RSX backend
help: Testing on real Windows with NVIDIA GPUs
Testing with real PlayStation and Xbox pads
Speed: the first level ran at 23.3 frames per second in one scripted run (PS3: 30)
notes: Needs your own copy of the game (disc dump, the 1.29 update and its decrypted EBOOT); the build happens on your PC. Partly playable: the first level is drawn and can be played with a pad; a scripted run gives about 23 frames per second (PS3: 30), and hand play is not measured.
